column1: # models.tsv — the reviewed model registry. ONE committed snapshot, read by bin/lib-models.sh.
# WHAT THIS IS: a snapshot of listed ids and exposed reasoning/context metadata,
# plus a conservative budget/risk policy class. No paid model call proves these rows.
# WHAT THIS IS NOT: a live capability probe, a price list, or a quality ranking.
#   - Runtime availability is per-account and per-flight. An id listed here can still be
#     refused by the host ("not enabled for you"). Never claim "available" from this file.
#   - The host's own model *catalog* is bigger than this file on purpose: ids we have not
#     reviewed stay OUT, so an unknown id is handled conservatively instead of guessed at.
#   - The `class` column is a BUDGET/RISK policy band, deliberately independent of
#     brand. It is not "best" and not "cheapest" — this repo holds no price data at all.
#   - The task/agent tool of a host may expose a DIFFERENT catalog than its `--model` flag
#     (observed on Copilot CLI 1.0.84-1). A task-only id is never handed to a CLI launcher.
# HOW TO REFRESH (copilot): `copilot help config` prints the authoritative `model:` id list for
# the installed CLI. `bin/models.sh snapshot` prints this provenance and the refresh command.
# Adding a row is a human decision: a new id does not get promoted just because it appeared.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated, no quoting):
#   id        concrete model id, exactly as the host CLI accepts it
#   family    the line this id belongs to; EXACTLY ONE row per family may be `current`
#   alias     canon tier alias (opus/sonnet/haiku) or `-`
#   class     frontier | mid | cheap   (budget/risk band; frontier needs a written rationale)
#   efforts   comma list of reasoning-effort levels, or `none` when the model has no reasoning knob
#   contexts  comma list of context tiers (default | long_context)
#   hosts     listing surfaces: copilot (CLI help) | copilot-task (delegation tool metadata)
#   status    current | legacy
#   source    provenance of the row
# Reviewed 2026-09-06: CLI ids from `copilot help config` 1.0.84-1;
# effort/context capabilities from this session's task tool schema, not from help's id list.
# All 27 CLI ids and the 26 task ids were compared; the union is 31 ids.
# Nine older task-described models are now recorded as legacy, NOT promoted or selected.
# Explicitly deferred (remain unknown/refused; do not invent capability metadata):
#   CLI only: claude-fable-5.1, claude-fable-5, claude-opus-4.8-fast, kimi-k3, kimi-k2.7-code
#     Reason: no per-model effort/context schema on the task surface in this session.
#   Task only: gpt-5.6-sol-fast, hydrafusion
#     Reason: distinct variants with no reviewed task-fit evidence; no profile change justified.
# Existing current rows/aliases and required subagent profiles are intentionally unchanged.
